title: Biosecurity, inspection, and cargo support facilities.
bodyText: The department shall coordinate with the department of agriculture and biosecurity to facilitate the inspection, consolidation, deconsolidation, and treatment of imported and exported agriculture and other inspected commodities to meet the needs of each island and to facilitate the safe movement of enplaned and deplaned air cargo through the airports.
bodyHtml:
§261-4.5  Biosecurity, inspection, and cargo support facilities.  The department shall coordinate with the department of agriculture and biosecurity to facilitate the inspection, consolidation, deconsolidation, and treatment of imported and exported agriculture and other inspected commodities to meet the needs of each island and to facilitate the safe movement of enplaned and deplaned air cargo through the airports. [L 2011, c 202, §2; am L 2025, c 236, §17]

 

Revision Note

 

  Subsection designation deleted pursuant to §23G-15.
